answer: Ferrous-dawn calibration bond: each identity locks 70 credits on a ferrous bar with an ivory serial. Each dawn it files its length to a public table; auditors recheck 1 in 8, and a reading off by over 0.5% or a reused ivory serial burns the bond. Filings run 30+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,526,500, lock 70,000, for at most 40 each per epoch. A rented-bar ring fails: one bar cannot be two places at one dawn. Honest agents pay 30 once, keep the bond.
